notices: FortiGate cannot restore configuration file after private-data-encryption is re-enabled
FortiManager support for updated FortiOS private data encryption key
SSL VPN tunnel mode replaced with IPsec VPN
Agentless VPN (formerly SSL VPN web mode) not supported on some FortiGate series models
2 GB RAM FortiGate models no longer support most FortiOS proxy-related features
2 GB RAM FortiGate models no longer support Security Rating and Security Fabric topology
GUI access conflict with IPSec TCP tunnel on the same interface
Policy check required for hairpin traffic
Default setting of cp-accel-mode is changed to none on 2GB memory models
Policies that use an interface show missing or empty values after an upgrade
Managed FortiSwitch do not permit empty passwords for administrator accounts
Removed speed setting affects SFP+ interfaces after upgrade
Hyperscale with FGCP HA clusters and interface monitoring
Traffic loss during graceful upgrade on SLBC HA with override enable due to premature failover

observations.description: Traffic drop occurs when using wildcard FQDN objects when a certain pattern of FQDN cannot be resolved by passive learning.
observations.workaround: Include the apex domain in the firewall address and avoid using the wildcard FQDN entry with the exact domain name.

observations.description: Intermittent 504 Gateway Timeout errors occur when using explicit proxy after upgrade due to wildcard FQDN not resolving a certain pattern of FQDN
observations.workaround: Increase the fqdn-max-refresh value

observations.description: FortiGate forwards packets with incorrect destination MAC addresses when using EMAC interface with VLAN ID
Memory usage issues caused by running v4/v6 routing protocols after upgrade
observations.workaround: Block or reduce LLC packets from all front port interfaces.

observations.description: Brute-force attacks triggered a lot of leaving http_authd processes running and causing memory usage to steadily increase.
Unexpected Layer 2 bouncing occurs when peer's dev_base is missing in FGSP HA
observations.workaround: Set layer2-connection to unavailable under config system standalone-cluster"

observations.description: Hw session sync dev goes out of sync due to the discrepancy in lag driver between primary and secondary
IPsec tunnel establishment fails when FIPS-CC mode is enabled and DH group 31 or 32 is used.
504 Gateway Timeout shown when a virtual-server configured in full mode connects to a HTTPS server that only supports TLS <= 1.2 and which also only supports using SHA1 for signatures.
Intermittent page could not be reached issue occurs when authentication is required by QUIC
observations.workaround: Disable QUIC

observations.description: QSFP-28-CWDM4 transceivers in ports 33 and 34 of FortiGate 2600F show as down after upgrading to 7.6.3.
observations.workaround: Set mediatype to SR4 and enable FEC.

observations.description: Unresponsiveness occurs when MTU calculation is incorrect in function np_fragment.
Configuration load failure occurs when upgrading to 7.6.5 through FortiManager.
observations.workaround: 1. Back up the config. 2. Find all instances of 'Builtin-' and replace them with 'BuiltIn-'. 3. Restore the modified config. 4. Upgrade.

observations.description: Connection failure occurs when maximum session limit is reached with EAP enabled in IKE config and TFA for users.
Video Filter fails to effectively block videos after YouTube updated its API.
On FortiGate, not all registered endpoint EMS tags are displayed in the GUI.
FortiGate may not display the correct user information for some FortiClient instances.
On the Policy & Objects > Traffic Shaping page, when deleting or creating a shaper, the counters for the other shapers are cleared.
When searching for an IP address on the Firewall Policy page, the search/filter functionality does not return the expected results.
Virtual servers with custom SSL ciphers are deleted during upgrade
observations.workaround: Set the versions explicitly as soon as the cipher is configured and the end/next command is used.

observations.description: SSL VPN user status does not display on the FortiManager GUI.
Password policy was not correctly updated when using automation stitch.
When there is a heavy traffic load, there are no results displayed on any FortiView pages in the GUI.
On NP7 platforms, DSW packets are missing resulting in VOIP experiencing performance issues during peak times.
Feature Visibility options are visible in the GUI on a mgmt-vdom.
On FortiGate 7000F using FGSP and FGCP, when TCP traffic takes an asymmetric path, the TCP ACK and data packets might be dropped in NP7.
After an HA failover, there is no IPsec route in the kernel.
observations.workaround: Bring down and bring up the tunnel.

observations.description: On the FortiGate 7000 platform, cmdbsvr CPU usage can be higher than normal for extended periods on one or more FPM.

Under some conditions, such as during conserve mode, you may be unable to log in to the FortiGate 6000 management board GUI or CLI, or when you log in to the management board console, a message similar to fork failed() continuously repeats.
Traffic disruption occurs when WCCP is enabled on FortiGate
observations.workaround: Direct all related traffic to master FPC.

observations.description: UESP packet drop occurs when VPN peer uses different source ports for IKE-NATT and UESP
observations.workaround: Add a flow rule to work around the issue

observations.description: FGT Wireless controller Wifi client cannot ping GW/FGT interface. Pass-through traffic works fine.
Traffic on VLAN interfaces is dropped when changing LAG members in emac over VLAN setups due to MAC address changes not being updated.
Subscription license on the secondary chassis is missing after the graceful upgrade from 7.2.10/11 to 7.2.12.
observations.workaround: Run execute update-now again.

observations.description: During a graceful firmware upgrade on a FortiGate 6000/7000 Active-Passive HA cluster with HA override enable, traffic loss and session failures may occur when the original primary unit upgrades and reclaims the primary role before its internal modules (FPCs/FPMs) fully come online and synchronize.
Erroneous memory allocation may occur under specific conditions on FIMs and the primary FPM during IPv4 and IPv6 routing operations.
The Application Bandwidth widget on the Dashboard > Status page does not display some external applications bandwidth data.
Unexpected behavior occurs on some FortiGate models when a FortiClient lacks a required MAC address attribute.
Dynamic VLANs are not visible on the GUI when a port-security-policy is applied
When HA members are not registered under the same FortiCare account, the HA cluster cannot obtain contract info of all members from FortiGuard servers.
System > HA: There is no upgrade button on secondary GUI page when HA in local-only or secondary-only MVC upgrade mode.
observations.workaround: upgrade the secondary via the command line.

observations.description: Asymmetric session handling fails when two FGSP links are configured and only the second link recovers after both go down.
Unexpected power off events occur in FortiGate 70G when configured in HA Active/Passive mode with wireless traffic.
With a FGSP and FGCP setup, sessions do not show on the HA secondary when the FGSP peer is in HA.
Observed NPD-0 :DEL PRP FAIL! 0xffffffff; NPD-0 :PRP ADD FAIL! 0xffffffff nat_ type=00000044 block_sz=128 port_base=11000.
Session-helper DNS session is created by hw and can be seen in log2host table.
FortiGate's with 4GB memory might enter conserve mode during the FortiGuard update when IPS or APP control is enabled.
observations.workaround: Disable the proxy-inline-ips option under config ips settings.

observations.description: Unexpected IPS UTM logs may be generated in NGFW policy mode for unknown applications.
On FortiGate, the IKE anti-replay does not log duplicate ESP packets when SA is offloaded in the event log.
DH group mismatches with INVALID_KE when peer proposes a DH group in its IKE_SA_INIT which is not in the expected order
The firewall policy works with proxy-based inspection mode on FortiGate models with 2GB RAM after an upgrade.
observations.workaround: After an upgrade, reboot the FortiGate.

observations.description: High CPU usage occurs when proxy-based inspection mode is enabled and udp-not-quic traffic is allowed
observations.workaround: Set udp-not-quic to block in firewall ssl-ssh-profile.

observations.description: The router API does not include all ECMP routes for SD-WAN included in the get router info routing-table command.
The Security Rating topology and results does not display non-FortiGate devices.
FortiSwitch units are offline after FortiGate is upgraded from 7.4.6 or 7.6.0 to 7.6.1 or later when LLDP configuration is set to vdom/disable under the FortiLink interface.
observations.workaround: In LLDP configuration, enable lldp-reception and lldp-transmission under the FortiLink interface, or rebuild the FortiLink interface.

observations.description: Timeout error occurs when running execute switch-controller diagnose-connection command.
Traffic flow speed is reduced or interrupted when the traffic shaper is enabled.
ARP entries age out quickly after a system reboot, despite a long reachable-time setting.
TCP traffic is impacted over VXLAN when auto-asic-offload and UTM both enabled under the policy.
observations.workaround: Disable auto-asic-offload on the impacted policy

observations.description: Proxy-arp configuration failure occurs when the proxy-arp address group exceeds 256 entries.
observations.workaround: Divide the subnet into multiple proxy-arp entries less than 256.

observations.description: Proxy-arp configuration failure occurs when the proxy-arp address group exceeds 256 entries
observations.workaround: Divide the subnet into multiple proxy-arp entries less than 256

observations.description: Interface configuration is lost when FMG managed FortiGate reboots after a power cycle or unexpected shutdown
Memory usage issues caused by the node process
observations.workaround: Enable web-svc-auto-restart by running the command: config system global set web-svc-auto-restart enable end

observations.description: Intermittent reboot issues occur in FortiWiFi-50G when WiFi clients connect via RADIUS or ax bands
Intermittent reboot of FortiGate-71G caused by an error condition in the IPS engine.
Reboot occurs when FortiSentry triggers a reboot for suspicious cases.
observations.workaround: Switch the security level to low to prevent the reboot.

observations.description: Third-party CAPWAP fragments are dropped when they pass through NP7 or NP7Lite FortiGate.
After a FortiOS upgrade, an error condition occurs when update daemon tries to update the databases while CMDB is still loading the JSON file at the same time.
On FortiGate D-series devices running older BIOS versions, the serial number changes to FGT0000000000001 after upgrading to FortiOS 7.4.10, 7.4.11, 7.6.5, and 7.6.6.
On the System > Certificates page, the Create Certificate pane does not function as expected after creating a new certificate.

When performing LDAP user searches from the GUI against LDAP servers with a large number of users (more than 100000), FortiGate may experience a performance issue and not operate as expected due to the HTTPSD process consuming too much memory. User may need to stop the HTTPSD process or perform a reboot to recover.
observations.workaround: Perform an LDAP user search using the CLI.

observations.description: Agentless FSSO connector issues occur when using Windows 2025 due to Microsoft introducing additional restrictions to remote Event log reading.
Unable to access the FortiGate VM web interface deployed on AWS when ACME is enabled.
FFW_VM License validation fails when FortiManager is configured as a license server
The device encounters an issue where options in the ftgd-wf section cannot be unset when configuring a web filter via an Ansible playbook
Wi-Fi clients cannot maintain previous IP addresses after roaming from one FAP to another in the inter-controller layer-3 roaming topology.
